|{1:* }{2:TODO}{1: }{3:[#A]}{1: Level one }{4::work:}|
|Body text of level one.|
|{5:** }{6:NEXT}{5: }{7:[#B]}{5: Level two }{8::home:errand:}|
|{9:*** }{10:DONE}{9: }{11:[#C]}{12: Level three}|
|{13:**** Level four with }{14:[#A]}{13: priority }{15::deep:}|
|{16:***** }{17:TODO}{16: Level five}|
|{1:* }{18:COMMENT}{1: A commented headline}|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | OrgTodo -> @comment.error [bold]
{3} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | OrgPriorityA -> DiagnosticError [bold]
{4} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | OrgTags -> @property [bold]
{5} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant
{6} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | OrgTodo -> @comment.error
{7} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | OrgPriorityB -> DiagnosticWarn
{8} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | OrgTags -> @property
{9} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier
{10} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgDone -> @comment.note
{11} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgHeadlineDone -> Comment | OrgPriorityC -> DiagnosticInfo
{12} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgHeadlineDone -> Comment
{13} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement [bold]
{14} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgPriorityA -> DiagnosticError [bold]
{15} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgTags -> @property [bold]
{16} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc
{17} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgTodo -> @comment.error
{18} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | OrgHeadlineComment -> Comment [bold]
